open: THE VIOLET IS HERS AND SHE HAD IT FIRST. Rebellious violet streaks through shoulder-length plum-wine red, and they predate Bryn’s by years — BRYN CAME LATER. It is now THEIR colour, and the direction of travel is wife-to-wife and only runs one way.
note:
THE ANONYMOUS COLUMNIST. Before St. Jonah's, Torie wrote anonymous pieces and pinned them to the CORK-BOARD at the high school she and Bryn attended. Bryn took the scraps DOWN off that board and kept them, because she knew the voice belonged to somebody important to her, years before she let herself finish the sentence. She carried them into hell, read them until the paper went soft, and CAN STILL RECITE EVERY ONE FROM MEMORY. She still has them.

THE LAST ONE, year three, the one Torie's therapist asked her to write: I LOVED THE PERSON THAT GAVE ME MY NAME ALL THOSE YEARS AGO, BUT I DON'T KNOW IF I CAN LOVE THE MONSTER THEY BECAME. Bryn read it inside with no way to answer it. Alice answered it for her in ink years before Torie could get there herself.

TEN INCHES, AND SHE WON THE ARGUMENT. Arc 5, against her sister: MY COCK'S BIGGER, I'M THE OLDEST versus NO, MINE'S BIGGER, I WAS BORN WITH IT. Settled by measurement at ten to Alice's eight point nine. She has been insufferable about her wife since the first time after Bryn dropped out of college, when she was braced for something demure around nine and a half to ten point two, got eleven and a half by six point six instead, and had to stop.
